new_words.english_meaning: A gathering of people who have not seen each other for a long time, especially a meeting of friends or family members.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: લાંબા સમય પછી મળેલા લોકોનો સમાવેશ, ખાસ કરીને મિત્રો અથવા પરિવારના સભ્યોની મુલાકાત.
new_words.usage_note: A reunion is often a happy and emotional occasion, where people reminisce about old times and catch up on each other's lives.
new_words.memory_tip: 'reun' = ફરીથી મળવું -> reunion = મળેલા લોકોનો સમાવેશ
examples: The family reunion was a wonderful opportunity to reconnect with distant relatives.
The school reunion was a chance to reminisce about old times and catch up on each other's lives.
The company is hosting a reunion for former employees.
The reunion was a highly anticipated event, with many people traveling from afar to attend.

new_words.english_meaning: A feeling or expression of sympathy and sorrow, especially on the death of someone.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દુઃખ અને સાંત્વનાની લાગણી અથવા અભિવ્યક્તિ, ખાસ કરીને કોઈના મૃત્યુ પર.
new_words.usage_note: Condolence is often expressed through words, actions, or gestures, such as sending a condolence message or attending a funeral.
examples: The family received many condolences after the loss of their loved one.
The company sent a condolence message to the bereaved family.
The condolence ceremony was a solemn and dignified occasion.
The community came together to offer condolences to the grieving family.

new_words.english_meaning: Polite and respectful behavior, especially towards someone of higher status or authority.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: આદરપૂર્ણ અને શિષ્ટ વર્તણૂક, ખાસ કરીને ઉચ્ચ હોદ્દા અથવા અધિકાર ધરાવતા વ્યક્તિ તરફ.
new_words.usage_note: Courtesy is an important aspect of social interaction, as it helps to build positive relationships and avoid offending others.
examples: The hotel staff showed excellent courtesy to the guests.
The company emphasizes the importance of courtesy in all interactions with customers.
The courtesy of the host made the evening a pleasant one.
The driver's courtesy and patience were impressive in the heavy traffic.

new_words.english_meaning: A formal or official quality, especially in behavior, language, or ceremony.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઔપચારિક અથવા અધિકૃત ગુણવત્તા, ખાસ કરીને વર્તણૂક, ભાષા, અથવા વિધિમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Formality is often required in official or professional settings, such as business meetings or government ceremonies.
examples: The formality of the wedding ceremony was impressive.
The company emphasizes the importance of formality in all business interactions.
The formality of the language used in the contract was necessary to avoid any misunderstandings.
The formality of the occasion required all guests to dress formally.

new_words.english_meaning: A message or expression of welcome or goodwill, especially on meeting someone or on a special occasion.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સ્વાગત અથવા શુભેચ્છાનું સંદેશ અથવા અભિવ્યક્તિ, ખાસ કરીને કોઈને મળવા અથવા વિશેષ પ્રસંગે.
new_words.usage_note: Greetings are an important part of social interaction, as they help to establish a positive tone and show respect for the other person.
examples: The greeting ceremony was a grand affair, with many dignitaries in attendance.
The company sent a greeting card to all employees on the occasion of the holiday.
The greeting message on the answering machine was friendly and welcoming.
The greeting between the two old friends was warm and affectionate.

new_words.english_meaning: The quality of being friendly and welcoming to guests or visitors.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: મહેમાનો અથવા મુલાકાતીઓ તરફ મિત્રતાપૂર્ણ અને સ્વાગતપૂર્ણ વર્તણૂકની ગુણવત્તા.
new_words.usage_note: Hospitality is an important aspect of social interaction, as it helps to create a positive and welcoming atmosphere for guests or visitors.
examples: The hospitality of the hotel staff was excellent, making our stay very comfortable.
The company emphasizes the importance of hospitality in all interactions with customers.
The hospitality of the host made the evening a pleasant one.
The hospitality industry is a significant contributor to the country's economy.

new_words.english_meaning: A formal or informal presentation of one person to another, especially in a social or business setting.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક વ્યક્તિનું બીજા વ્યક્તિને રજૂઆત કરવી, ખાસ કરીને સામાજિક અથવા વ્યવસાયિક સેટિંગમાં.
new_words.usage_note: Introductions are an important part of social interaction, as they help to establish relationships and facilitate communication.
examples: The introduction ceremony was a grand affair, with many dignitaries in attendance.
The company sent a formal introduction letter to all new employees.
The introduction between the two old friends was warm and affectionate.
The introduction to the new project was very impressive, with many innovative ideas presented.

new_words.english_meaning: The quality of being polite, courteous, and respectful in behavior or speech.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વર્તણૂક અથવા બોલચાલમાં આદરપૂર્ણ, શિષ્ટ અને સમ્માનજનક હોવાની ગુણવત્તા.
new_words.usage_note: Politeness is an important aspect of social interaction, as it helps to create a positive and respectful atmosphere.
examples: The politeness of the hotel staff was impressive, making our stay very comfortable.
The company emphasizes the importance of politeness in all interactions with customers.
The politeness of the host made the evening a pleasant one.
The politeness of the stranger was a welcome surprise in the busy city.

new_words.english_meaning: A feeling of admiration or esteem for someone or something, especially because of their qualities or achievements.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યક્તિ અથવા વસ્તુ માટે પ્રશંસા અથવા આદરની લાગણી, ખાસ કરીને તેમના ગુણો અથવા સિદ્ધિઓને કારણે.
new_words.usage_note: Respect is an important aspect of social interaction, as it helps to create a positive and harmonious atmosphere.
examples: The respect of the students for their teacher was evident in their behavior.
The company emphasizes the importance of respect in all interactions with customers.
The respect of the host for his guests was apparent in the way he treated them.
The respect for the environment is essential for our survival.

new_words.english_meaning: A formal or informal greeting, especially one used to address someone in writing or in person.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઔપચારિક અથવા અનૌપચારિક સ્વાગત, ખાસ કરીને લેખન અથવા વ્યક્તિગત રીતે કોઈને સંબોધવા માટે વપરાતું.
new_words.usage_note: Salutations are an important part of social interaction, as they help to establish a positive and respectful tone.
examples: The salutation at the beginning of the letter was formal and respectful.
The company uses a standard salutation in all its official communications.
The salutation between the two old friends was warm and affectionate.
The salutation ceremony was a grand affair, with many dignitaries in attendance.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to get someone's attention or to apologize for interrupting.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈનું ધ્યાન આકર્ષિત કરવા અથવા વિક્ષેપ કરવા બદલ માફી માંગવા માટે વપરાતી શિષ્ટ રીત.
collocations: Excuse me, can I ask you something?
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to politely interrupt someone or to apologize for a minor mistake.
examples: Excuse me, where is the restroom?
Excuse me, can I ask you a question?
Excuse me, I think you dropped something.
Excuse me, sorry to interrupt, but I need to tell you something.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to ask for permission to do something.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક કરવાની પરવાનગી માંગવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to politely ask for permission or to request something.
examples: May I have a cup of coffee, please?
May I ask you a question?
May I go to the bathroom?
May I take a look at that book?

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to make a request or to express gratitude.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈને વિનંતી કરવા અથવા આભાર વ્યક્ત કરવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this word to make a request or to express gratitude in a polite way.
examples: Please help me with this task.
Please come in and have a seat.
Please pass the salt.
Please don't forget to call me.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to express gratitude or appreciation.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: આભાર અથવા કૃતજ્ઞતા વ્યક્ત કરવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to express gratitude or appreciation in a polite way.
examples: Thank you for your help.
Thank you very much for the gift.
Thank you for coming to my party.
Thank you for listening to me.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to apologize or express regret.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: માફી માંગવા અથવા ખેદ વ્યક્ત કરવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this word to apologize or express regret in a polite way.
examples: Sorry to hear about your loss.
Sorry for the mistake.
Sorry to interrupt, but...
Sorry I'm late.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to greet someone or to make them feel comfortable.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈને અભિવાદન કરવા અથવા તેમને સુખદ અનુભવ કરાવવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this word to greet someone or to make them feel comfortable in a polite way.
examples: Welcome to our home.
Welcome back to the office.
You're welcome to join us.
Welcome to the party!

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to offer someone something or to give them permission to take something.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈને કંઈક ઓફર કરવા અથવા તેમને કંઈક લેવાની પરવાનગી આપવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to offer someone something or to give them permission to take something in a polite way.
examples: Help yourself to another cup of coffee.
Please help yourself to the dessert.
Feel free to help yourself to anything you need.
Help yourself, and then we'll talk.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to express regret or to apologize for something.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ખેદ અથવા માફી માંગવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to express regret or to apologize for something in a polite way.
new_words.memory_tip: 'afraid' = ડરું -> I'm afraid = મને ડર લાગે છે
examples: I'm afraid I forgot your birthday.
I'm afraid we're out of stock.
I'm afraid I won't be able to attend.
I'm afraid that's not possible.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to ask for permission or to make a request.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: પરવાનગી માંગવા અથવા વિનંતી કરવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
collocations: If you don't mind my asking
If you don't mind, could I...
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to ask for permission or to make a request in a polite way.
new_words.memory_tip: 'mind' = મન -> if you don't mind = જો તમને વાંધો ન આવે
examples: If you don't mind, could I ask you a question?
If you don't mind, I'll take a look.
If you don't mind my asking, what's your name?
If you don't mind, I'll join you later.

new_words.english_meaning: A polite way to respond to a request or to show that something is not a problem.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વિનંતીનો જવાબ આપવા અથવા કંઈક સમસ્યા નથી એવું દર્શાવવાની શિષ્ટ રીત.
new_words.usage_note: Use this phrase to respond to a request or to show that something is not a problem in a polite way.
new_words.memory_tip: 'no' = ના -> no problem = કોઈ સમસ્યા નથી
examples: No problem, I can help you.
No problem, thanks for asking.
No problem at all, I'll do it.
No problem, I'll take care of it.

new_words.english_meaning: On the way to a place, while traveling. En route is used to describe something that happens or is done during a journey.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: માર્ગ પર, પ્રવાસ દરમિયાન. કોઈ જગ્યાએ જતી વખતે થતી વાતો અથવા કરવામાં આવતી બાબતો.
new_words.usage_note: En route is often used in formal or official contexts, such as travel or transportation.
examples: The bus stopped en route to pick up more passengers.
We saw a beautiful landscape en route to the mountains.
The package was lost en route to its destination.
The flight attendants served snacks en route to New York.

new_words.english_meaning: In the process of being transported from one place to another. In transit is used to describe something that is being moved or shipped.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક જગ્યાથી બીજી જગ્યાએ લઈ જવાની પ્રક્રિયામાં. ટ્રાન્ઝિટ એ કોઈ વસ્તુને લઈ જવાની અથવા મોકલવાની પ્રક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: In transit is often used in formal or official contexts, such as shipping or logistics.
new_words.memory_tip: 'in transit' = પ્રવાહી અવસ્થામાં -> એક જગ્યાથી બીજી જગ્યાએ લઈ જતી વખતે
examples: The package is in transit and will arrive tomorrow.
The company specializes in shipping goods in transit.
The traveler's luggage was lost in transit.
The flight was delayed, and the passengers were stuck in transit.

new_words.english_meaning: To change direction and go back the way you came. Turn back is used to describe the action of reversing one's course.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: તમે આવ્યા તે રસ્તે પાછા ફરવું. ટર્ન બેક એ પોતાનો રસ્તો બદલવાની અને પાછા જવાની ક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Turn back is often used in informal contexts, such as giving directions or advice.
new_words.memory_tip: 'turn back' = પાછો ફરવો -> તમે આવ્યા તે રસ્તે પાછા જવું
examples: We got lost, so we had to turn back and ask for directions.
The hikers decided to turn back due to the bad weather.
The driver had to turn back because of the roadblock.
The traveler turned back to get her forgotten passport.

new_words.english_meaning: To become lost or unable to find one's way. Get lost is used to describe the state of being disoriented or confused about one's location.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ખોવાઈ જવું અથવા પોતાનો રસ્તો શોધી ન શકવો. ગેટ લોસ્ટ એ ખોવાઈ જવાની અથવા ગુંચવણમાં હોવાની સ્થિતિનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Get lost is often used in informal contexts, such as giving advice or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'get lost' = ખોવાઈ જવો -> પોતાનો રસ્તો શોધી ન શકવો
examples: I got lost in the city because I didn't have a map.
The tourist got lost in the airport and couldn't find the gate.
The driver got lost on the way to the hotel.
The child got lost in the crowd and started crying.

new_words.english_meaning: To take a different route or path, often because the usual one is blocked or closed. Make a detour is used to describe the action of taking a secondary route.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક અલગ રસ્તો અથવા માર્ગ લેવો, ઘણીવાર કારણ કે સામાન્ય રસ્તો બંધ અથવા બંધ છે. મેક એ ડિટોર એ ગૌણ માર્ગ લેવાની ક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Make a detour is often used in formal or official contexts, such as giving directions or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'make a detour' = અલગ રસ્તો લેવો -> ગૌણ માર્ગ લેવો
examples: We had to make a detour because of the road construction.
The driver made a detour to avoid the traffic jam.
The hikers made a detour to see the scenic view.
The traveler made a detour to visit the local market.

new_words.english_meaning: To take a route that is shorter or more direct than the usual one. Take a shortcut is used to describe the action of taking a more efficient path.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક રસ્તો લેવો જે ટૂંકો અથવા વધુ સીધો છે પરંપરાગત એક. ટેક એ શોર્ટકટ એ વધુ કાર્યક્ષમ માર્ગ લેવાની ક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Take a shortcut is often used in informal contexts, such as giving advice or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'take a shortcut' = ટૂંકો રસ્તો લેવો -> વધુ કાર્યક્ષમ માર્ગ લેવો
examples: I took a shortcut through the park to get to work faster.
The driver took a shortcut to avoid the traffic jam.
The hikers took a shortcut to reach the summit earlier.
The student took a shortcut to finish the project quickly.

new_words.english_meaning: To be doing something correctly or to be making progress towards a goal. Be on the right track is used to describe the state of being on the correct path.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વસ્તુ સાચી રીતે કરવી અથવા લક્ષ્ય તરફ પ્રગતિ કરવી. બી ઓન ધ રાઇટ ટ્રેક એ સાચા માર્ગ પર હોવાની સ્થિતિનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
synonyms: be heading in the right direction
collocations: be on the right track to
new_words.usage_note: Be on the right track is often used in informal contexts, such as giving advice or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'be on the right track' = સાચા માર્ગ પર હોવું -> સાચા માર્ગ પર હોવું
examples: I think I'm on the right track with this project.
The team is on the right track to winning the championship.
She's on the right track to becoming a successful entrepreneur.
He's on the right track to recovery after the illness.

new_words.english_meaning: To become distracted or sidetracked and lose focus on the main goal or task. Get off track is used to describe the state of being diverted from the intended path.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વિક્ષેપિત થવું અથવા મુખ્ય લક્ષ્ય અથવા કાર્યથી ધ્યાન ભટકાવવું. ગેટ ઓફ ટ્રેક એ ઇરાદા કરેલા માર્ગથી દૂર થવાની સ્થિતિનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Get off track is often used in informal contexts, such as giving advice or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'get off track' = માર્ગથી દૂર થવું -> ઇરાદા કરેલા માર્ગથી દૂર થવું
examples: I got off track and forgot what I was doing.
The team got off track and started arguing.
She got off track and started browsing social media.
He got off track and started watching videos.

new_words.english_meaning: To discover or determine the correct path or direction. Find one's way is used to describe the action of locating or identifying the correct route.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સાચો માર્ગ અથવા દિશા શોધવી અથવા નક્કી કરવી. ફાઈન્ડ વન્સ વે એ સાચા માર્ગને શોધવા અથવા ઓળખવાની ક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Find one's way is often used in informal contexts, such as giving directions or describing a situation.
new_words.memory_tip: 'find one's way' = પોતાનો રસ્તો શોધવો -> સાચો માર્ગ શોધવો
examples: It took me a while to find my way around the new city.
The hikers found their way to the summit using a map.
The driver found his way through the traffic jam.
The tourist found her way to the hotel with the help of a local.

new_words.english_meaning: To take charge or assume the role of leader. Take the lead is used to describe the action of becoming the guide or director.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: આગેવાની લેવી અથવા નેતાની ભૂમિકા સ્વીકારવી. ટેક ધ લીડ એ માર્ગદર્શક અથવા દિશાદર્શક બનવાની ક્રિયાનું વર્ણન કરે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Take the lead is often used in formal or official contexts, such as business or leadership.
new_words.memory_tip: 'take the lead' = આગેવાની લેવી -> માર્ગદર્શક બનવું
examples: The project manager took the lead on the new initiative.
The team captain took the lead and guided the team to victory.
The entrepreneur took the lead in the industry with her innovative ideas.
The teacher took the lead in the classroom and engaged the students.

new_words.english_meaning: To decide which things are most important and should be done first.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કામોને મહત્વના અને ઓછા મહત્વના તરીકે વર્ગીકૃત કરવું અને સૌથી મહત્વના કામોને પહેલાં કરવું.
new_words.usage_note: Prioritize is often used in formal and business settings.
examples: I need to prioritize my tasks for the day.
She prioritizes her family over her career.
The company will prioritize customer satisfaction.
The manager asked the team to prioritize the most urgent projects.

new_words.english_meaning: To give someone the authority to do a particular task or make a decision.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ વ્યક્તિને કોઈ વિશિષ્ટ કામ કરવા અથવા નિર્ણય લેવાનો અધિકાર આપવો.
new_words.usage_note: Delegate is often used in business and management contexts.
examples: The manager delegated the task to her assistant.
The company will delegate the decision to the board of directors.
She delegates her workload to her team members.
The president delegated the power to the vice president.

new_words.english_meaning: To delay or put off doing something, often because it is unpleasant or boring.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કામ કરવામાં વિલંબ કરવો અથવા ટાળવું, ઘણીવાર કારણ કે તે અપ્રિય અથવા બોરિંગ છે.
new_words.usage_note: Procrastinate is often used in informal contexts.
examples: I tend to procrastinate when it comes to doing my homework.
She procrastinated on the project until the deadline was near.
He procrastinates about making important decisions.
The student procrastinated on the assignment and now it's too late to submit it.

new_words.english_meaning: To do several things at the same time, such as working on a computer while talking on the phone.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એકસાથે ઘણી વસ્તુઓ કરવી, જેમ કે કમ્પ્યુટર પર કામ કરવું જ્યારે ફોન પર વાત કરવી.
new_words.usage_note: Multitask is often used in modern workplaces.
examples: I can multitask and finish all my work on time.
She can multitask and talk on the phone while driving.
He is good at multitasking and can handle several projects at once.
The employee was able to multitask and meet the deadline.

new_words.english_meaning: A time management technique where you schedule large blocks of uninterrupted time to focus on a task.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સમય વ્યવસ્થાપનની એક ટેકનિક જ્યાં તમે એક કામ પર ધ્યાન કેન્દ્રિત કરવા માટે અવિચ્છિન્ન સમયના મોટા બ્લોક્સને શેડ્યૂલ કરો છો.
new_words.usage_note: Time-blocking is often used in productivity and time management contexts.
examples: I use time-blocking to schedule my day and stay focused.
The company uses time-blocking to manage their projects and meet deadlines.
She uses time-blocking to prioritize her tasks and avoid distractions.
The employee was able to use time-blocking to increase his productivity and efficiency.

new_words.english_meaning: A productivity technique where you group similar tasks together and complete them in one session.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ઉત્પાદકતાની ટેકનિક જ્યાં તમે સમાન કામોને એકસાથે જૂથ કરો છો અને તેમને એક સેશનમાં પૂર્ણ કરો છો.
new_words.usage_note: Batching is often used in productivity and time management contexts.
examples: I use batching to manage my emails and respond to them all at once.
The company uses batching to process their orders and reduce delays.
She uses batching to clean her house and get everything done in one day.
The employee was able to use batching to increase his efficiency and reduce his workload.

new_words.english_meaning: A time management technique where you work in focused 25-minute increments, followed by a 5-minute break.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સમય વ્યવસ્થાપનની ટેકનિક જ્યાં તમે 25-મિનિટના સમયગાળામાં કામ કરો છો, ત્યારબાદ 5-મિનિટનો વિરામ.
new_words.usage_note: Pomodoro is often used in productivity and time management contexts.
examples: I use the Pomodoro technique to stay focused and avoid distractions.
The company uses Pomodoro to boost their employees' productivity.
She uses Pomodoro to study for her exams and retain information better.
The employee was able to use Pomodoro to increase his work efficiency and reduce his stress levels.

new_words.english_meaning: To use machines or computers to do a task, so that it can be done automatically without human intervention.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: મશીનો અથવા કમ્પ્યુટરોનો ઉપયોગ કરવો કોઈ કામ કરવા માટે, જેથી તે સ્વયંસંચાલિત રીતે માનવ હસ્તક્ષેપ વિના કરી શકાય.
new_words.usage_note: Automate is often used in technological and industrial contexts.
examples: The company automated their manufacturing process to increase efficiency.
She automated her email responses to save time.
He automated his home lighting system to make it more convenient.
The employee was able to automate the data entry process and reduce the workload.

new_words.english_meaning: To give a task or job to someone outside the company or organization, so that it can be done more efficiently or at a lower cost.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કોઈ કામ અથવા નોકરીને કંપની અથવા સંસ્થાની બહારના કોઈને આપવું, જેથી તે વધુ કારકિર્દી અથવા ઓછા ખર્ચે કરી શકાય.
new_words.usage_note: Outsource is often used in business and management contexts.
examples: The company outsourced their customer service to a call center.
She outsourced her accounting work to a freelance accountant.
He outsourced his web development project to a team of experts.
The employee was able to outsource the data analysis task and focus on more important work.

new_words.english_meaning: To reduce the size or amount of something, such as a company, a workforce, or a budget.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંપની, કાર્યબળ, અથવા બજેટ જેવી કોઈ વસ્તુનું કદ અથવા પ્રમાણ ઘટાડવું.
new_words.usage_note: Downsize is often used in business and economic contexts.
examples: The company downsized their operations to reduce costs.
She downsized her team to focus on more important projects.
He downsized his budget to save money.
The employee was affected by the company's decision to downsize and had to look for a new job.

new_words.english_meaning: Feeling or expressing overwhelming happiness or excitement.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય ખુશી અથવા ઉત્સાહની લાગણી થતી હોય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe extreme happiness or excitement, especially in response to a significant event.
examples: The crowd went ecstatic when their team won the championship.
She was ecstatic about her new job offer.
The news of the wedding made the whole family ecstatic.
The fans were ecstatic when their favorite singer performed live.

new_words.english_meaning: Feeling happy and also a little sad when you think about something from the past.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: ભૂતકાળની વાતો યાદ કરતી વખતે ખુશી અને થોડો દુઃખ એમ બંને લાગણીઓ થતી હોય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a bittersweet feeling when remembering the past.
examples: The old photograph made her nostalgic for her childhood.
The smell of freshly baked cookies was nostalgic for him.
The song brought back nostalgic memories of their first date.
The nostalgic atmosphere of the old café made it a popular spot.

new_words.english_meaning: Peaceful and untroubled; calm and quiet.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: શાંત, પ્રશાંત અને નિર્વિકાર.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a peaceful and calming environment or state of mind.
examples: The serene beauty of the lake was breathtaking.
The serene atmosphere of the spa helped her relax.
The serene music played in the background was soothing.
The serene expression on her face made her look peaceful.

new_words.english_meaning: Feeling extremely happy and excited, often because of a thrilling experience.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય ખુશી અને ઉત્સાહથી ભરાયેલું, ઘણીવાર રોમાંચક અનુભવને કારણે.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe an intense feeling of happiness and excitement, often after a thrilling experience.
examples: She felt exhilarated after skydiving for the first time.
The crowd was exhilarated by the rock concert.
The news of the promotion left him exhilarated.
The exhilarated feeling of traveling to a new country was exciting.

new_words.english_meaning: Having a feeling of sadness or depression, often without a clear reason.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: દુઃખ અથવા નિરાશાની લાગણી, ઘણીવાર સ્પષ્ટ કારણ વિના.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a feeling of sadness or depression without a clear reason.
examples: The rainy day put her in a melancholy mood.
The melancholy music suited his somber mood.
The old, abandoned house had a melancholy atmosphere.
He felt melancholy after the breakup.

new_words.english_meaning: Feeling or expressing intense happiness or excitement.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય ખુશી અથવા ઉત્સાહની લાગણી થતી હોય.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe an intense feeling of happiness or excitement.
examples: The crowd was euphoric when their team won the championship.
She felt euphoric after receiving the good news.
The euphoric atmosphere of the party was infectious.
He was euphoric about his new job opportunity.

new_words.english_meaning: Feeling extremely sad or hopeless.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: અતિશય દુઃખી અથવા નિરાશ.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a state of extreme sadness or hopelessness.
examples: The news of the loss made him despondent.
She felt despondent after the breakup.
The despondent atmosphere of the hospital was depressing.
He was despondent about his future prospects.

new_words.english_meaning: Accepting something unpleasant or unwanted because it cannot be changed.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક અપ્રિય અથવા અવાંછિત હોવા છતાં તેને સ્વીકારવું કારણ કે તે બદલી શકાતું નથી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a state of acceptance or surrender, often due to a lack of choice or control.
examples: She felt resigned to her fate.
He was resigned to the fact that he would never see his family again.
The resigned look on his face showed his acceptance of the situation.
She was resigned to the idea of working long hours.

new_words.english_meaning: Having a sullen or gloomy disposition; sulky.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કડક અથવા ધૂંધળી વૃત્તિ; દુઃખી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe someone with a gloomy or sulky disposition.
examples: The morose expression on his face made him look unapproachable.
She had a morose mood after the argument.
The morose atmosphere of the abandoned house was eerie.
He was known for his morose personality.

new_words.english_meaning: Thinking deeply and often sadly about something.
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કંઈક વિશે ઊંડો વિચાર કરવો, ઘણીવાર દુઃખી એવી લાગણીથી.
new_words.usage_note: Often used to describe a state of deep thought, often with a tinge of sadness.
examples: The pensive expression on her face showed her deep thinking.
He was in a pensive mood after the loss.
The pensive atmosphere of the library was conducive to study.
She was pensive about her future plans.

new_words.english_meaning: Finished or done before the planned time
new_words.gujarati_meaning: નક્કી કરેલા સમય પહેલાં પૂર્ણ થયેલું કામ.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe a task or project that is completed before the expected time
examples: The construction project was finished ahead of schedule.
We were able to deliver the product ahead of schedule.
The team worked efficiently and completed the task ahead of schedule.
The new employee was able to learn the job ahead of schedule.

new_words.english_meaning: A buildup of tasks or jobs that need to be done
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એવું કામ કે જે થતાં વિલંબ થયો હોય અને હવે પૂર્ણ કરવાની જરૂર છે.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe a situation where there is a large amount of work that needs to be done
examples: The company has a large backlog of orders to fill.
The doctor has a backlog of patients to see.
The manufacturer has a backlog of products to produce.
The IT department has a backlog of issues to resolve.

new_words.english_meaning: A date or time by which something must be done
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એવો સમય કે જેના અંતે કામ પૂર્ણ થવું જોઈએ.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe a specific time by which a task or project must be completed
examples: The deadline for the project is next Friday.
We need to meet the deadline for the report.
The company has extended the deadline for the application.
The student was worried about missing the deadline for the assignment.

new_words.english_meaning: Time worked beyond the normal working hours
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સામાન્ય કાર્ય કલાકોની બહાર કામ કરવું.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe the time worked beyond the normal working hours
examples: The employee worked overtime to finish the project.
The company pays overtime to its employees.
The worker is entitled to overtime pay for the extra hours worked.
The manager asked the team to work overtime to meet the deadline.

new_words.english_meaning: The quality of being on time or doing things at the expected time
new_words.gujarati_meaning: સમયસરતા અને નિયમિતતાનું ગુણ.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe the quality of being on time or doing things at the expected time
examples: Punctuality is important in the workplace.
The teacher emphasized the importance of punctuality in class.
The company values punctuality and rewards employees who are on time.
The student's punctuality was impressive, and she never missed a class.

new_words.english_meaning: The process of planning and organizing tasks or events
new_words.gujarati_meaning: કામો અથવા ઘટનાઓનું આયોજન અને સંગઠન.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe the process of planning and organizing tasks or events
examples: The manager is responsible for scheduling the meetings.
The teacher creates a schedule for the lesson plans.
The company uses scheduling software to organize its tasks.
The student makes a schedule to manage her time effectively.

new_words.english_meaning: The process of planning and controlling how much time to spend on different activities
new_words.gujarati_meaning: વિવિધ પ્રવૃત્તિઓ પર કેટલો સમય ખર્ચવાનું તેનું આયોજન અને નિયંત્રણ.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe the process of planning and controlling how much time to spend on different activities
examples: Good time management is essential for success.
The company offers time management training to its employees.
The student uses a planner to improve her time management skills.
The manager prioritizes tasks to optimize time management.

new_words.english_meaning: A region that follows a uniform standard time
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એક પ્રદેશ કે જેમાં એક જ સમય માનક અનુસરવામાં આવે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe a region that follows a uniform standard time
examples: The company has offices in different time zones.
The traveler had to adjust to a new time zone.
The meeting was scheduled across multiple time zones.
The time zone difference caused confusion with the schedule.

new_words.english_meaning: A list of tasks that need to be done
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એવી યાદી કે જેમાં કરવાના કામોની યાદી બનાવવામાં આવી છે.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe a list of tasks that need to be done
examples: I make a to-do list every morning to stay organized.
The manager checks off the to-do list to track progress.
The student uses a planner to keep track of her to-do list.
The team prioritizes the to-do list to focus on the most important tasks.

new_words.english_meaning: The time it takes to complete a task or project and have it ready to use again
new_words.gujarati_meaning: એવો સમય કે જેમાં એક કામ અથવા પ્રોજેક્ટ પૂર્ણ થાય છે અને તેને ફરીથી ઉપયોગમાં લેવા માટે તૈયાર કરવામાં આવે છે.
new_words.usage_note: Used to describe the time it takes to complete a task or project and have it ready to use again
new_words.memory_tip: 'Turn' = ફેરવું -> કામ પૂર્ણ થયા પછી ફરીથી ઉપયોગમાં લેવા માટે
examples: The company aims to reduce the turnaround time for customer requests.
The team worked to improve the turnaround for the project.
The manufacturer increased the turnaround for the production line.
The IT department measured the turnaround time for the system update.
